title: Choose Kingdom Network’s visual world
question: Each direction keeps marketplace clarity while giving ministry credentials a distinct identity. Choose one, or re-roll.

options.label: The Living Score
options.lineage: choral scores, service orders, and conductor’s marks
options.thesis: Every calling becomes a legible progression, with courses and credentials joining like voices toward one earned title.
options.viewport: A typographic marketplace opens as four horizontal pathway staves; products, prerequisites, issuing churches, and prices align in one glance beside a direct search.
options.risk: The score grammar must remain immediately shoppable, never precious or ceremonial.

raised.raise: Guide words always show the first and last outcomes currently in view.
One monumental seal-shaped field gives the first viewport graphic authority.
Motion belongs to the joining of pathway steps, not decorative entrances.
Repeated offerings share a strict visual ruler for rapid price and requirement comparison.
The selected pathway retains a visible trace as people browse.
Every final credential remains traceable to its exact prerequisites.

options.label: The Ministry Register
options.lineage: official registries, embossed seals, and archival ledgers
options.thesis: A trusted public register where offerings are products, issuers are accountable, and every credential has provenance.
options.viewport: A bold credential finder sits beside an oversized live register entry, followed immediately by compact listings and verified issuer marks.
options.risk: It is the most familiar fit for credentials and can feel institutional if commerce loses its pace.

options.label: The Calling Lexicon
options.thesis: Ministry outcomes become precise entries, each granted the exact apparatus its path requires.
options.viewport: A shoulder index names Credentials, Courses, Invitations, and Churches while a dense, highly legible result field begins immediately.
options.case: It matches product clarity and gives complex prerequisites superb structure; it identifies with scholarship more than living ministry.
options.risk: Dense editorial rhythm can slow the urgent buyer unless price and action remain visually dominant.

options.label: The Commissioned Figure
options.thesis: Courses and credentials compose one ministerial identity from a few exact planes.
options.viewport: A monumental human figure assembles from pathway products while search and pricing sit on the same strict grid.
options.case: Audience identification is strong, but a monumental figure gives fewer listings and prerequisite details room to breathe.
options.kept: Commit one unmistakable graphic field instead of decorating a standard marketplace.
options.risk: Product discovery could become secondary to the poster moment.

options.label: The Calling Portal
options.thesis: The marketplace opens as a living field that responds to a seeker’s direction.
options.viewport: An atmospheric full-screen field carries one enormous outcome question and thin category wayfinding.
options.case: Memorable but weaker at price comparison, low-bandwidth access, and the sober trust required for official documents.
options.kept: Make interaction express the mechanism instead of scattering hover effects.
options.risk: Performance and atmosphere would compete with trust and immediate commerce.

options.label: The Readiness Bridge
options.thesis: Each credential path shows exactly how close a learner is to readiness.
options.viewport: A long row of outcome meters compares progress, time, price, and issuing church at once.
options.case: Excellent comparison mechanics, but the recording-studio world misidentifies both ministry and trust.
options.kept: Give repeated offerings one strict ruler so comparison is effortless.
options.risk: It can turn sacred formation into instrumentation.

options.label: The Illuminated Way
options.thesis: Every explored calling leaves a luminous trail toward the credential it unlocks.
options.viewport: Touch or pointer movement connects courses, churches, and credentials across a dark pathway map.
options.case: The journey metaphor is strong, but darkness and animation weaken catalog scanning and low-bandwidth delivery.
options.kept: Keep the user’s explored pathway visibly connected across browsing modes.
options.risk: A beautiful path could obscure the exact product and price.

options.label: The Woven Credential
options.thesis: Many exact learning decisions weave into one final church-issued credential.
options.viewport: A gold credential motif resolves as prerequisite rows are completed beside a compact marketplace index.
options.case: It explains composable credentials beautifully, but does not naturally explain direct products or invitation letters.
options.kept: Make every issued outcome traceable to the exact prerequisites beneath it.
options.risk: The textile metaphor can overwhelm the breadth of the marketplace.

canonCard.label: The polished marketplace standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar course-and-credential marketplace, executed with clear search, category rails, product cards, and partner logos.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional split hero leads into horizontal product rails and a church acquisition band.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable, but visually interchangeable with education marketplaces.
